title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Australian PM warns of AI’s ‘furious pace’ after agent breached government site
summary: Anthony Albanese said governments must help shape AI’s development, after revealing earlier that an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on an Australian Medicare data portal.

title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
summary: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

title: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents
summary: Block joins Google, Microsoft, AWS and Coinbase in backing x402, an open payment standard enabling agentic AI commerce.

title: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.

title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
summary: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.

title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
summary: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
summary: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.

title: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
summary: Although the CFTC chair did not say the failed vote on the CLARITY Act was behind new rules for authorized crypto entities, he said the move was “to provide regulatory clarity.“

title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
summary: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.
